title: 2026-10-21 live aggregate verified; individual unresolved rows need review
detail: GitHub's successful scheduled production run 39565977314 reports a complete 91-record Hotspawn inventory, including 29 upcoming records, cross-checked against the fixture API and both lobby pages. Its check annotations report 26 resolved entries and 3 unresolved in the separate complete-picks ladder (25 directional picks), while the featured view reports 19 picks and 10 unresolved. These are different views and must not be combined. The workflow's row-source audit reports 599 rows, 585 official-linked, 5 explicitly flagged, 9 navigation rows, and 0 violations. The signed Pages archive could not be downloaded by this audit workspace (EOF), and aggregate annotations do not name the individual unresolved fixtures or expose their per-team probabilities. This is an independent audit limitation, not a reported deployment failure: the production build, deploy and verify_live steps succeeded. The checked-in JSON is from 15 October and is not substituted for current rows. Review current pick cards and their evidence on the live site; unsupported values remain blank.
